Chef@1 is retired: what to do

The short answer

Retirement date
2026-10-15
Removal date
2027-03-15. Pipelines that still use it fail after removal.
Replacement
No replacement task.
Kind of migration
no replacement: platform retired or external tool
Automatic rewrite
No. This task needs a manual migration. trasloco modernize --check still finds the step.

Questions

When is Chef@1 removed?

Chef@1: retirement date 2026-10-15, removal date 2027-03-15. Pipelines that still use it fail after removal.

What replaces Chef@1?

There is no replacement task for Chef@1. Use the "Chef" extension or a script step.

Can trasloco fix Chef@1 automatically?

No. This task needs a manual migration. trasloco modernize --check still finds the step.
